content: नालिः, -ली {%f.%} [नल्-णिच् इन् वा ङीप्] .²1 Any tubular vessel of the body. .²2 A hollow stalk, especially that of the lotus. .²3 A period of 24 minutes (घटिका). .²4 An instrument for boring an elephantʼs ear. .²5 A canal, drain. .²6 A lotus flower. .²7 A piece of metal on which the hours are struck (घटी).
